title: LAPS HVAC

title: Graticule

features: Live four-channel scope traces with phosphor trails behind the hero
Eight canvas-drawn app screens: scope, logic, FFT, Bode, PCB and more
Scroll-spy side rail with a trigger-style progress ruler, plus light/dark themes
Remote-bench dashboard, pricing toggle and a validated signup form

title: Plumbline
summary: A website for a fictional crypto data network, with a rotating hero headline, animated illustrations, simulated live numbers and working menus, search and forms.
features: Rotating hero headline over a live animated node network
Isometric platform illustration with a swaying plumb bob and flowing data
Ticking value counter and a simulated live feed monitor
Mega menus, keyboard search, tabbed use cases and a validated contact dialog
